⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: You close the GE dishwasher door and press Start, the amber light blinks, and it beeps 3 times every minute without starting (as if the door is still open).

Verified technical root cause: Worn micro-switches inside the top-mounted door latch assembly (WD21X10490) failing to signal both door closure poles to the main UI board.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Press and hold 'Select Cycle' and 'Start' simultaneously for 5 seconds: if all LEDs blink, the dishwasher thinks the door is open.
  2. Open the dishwasher door, unscrew the 2 mounting screws holding the plastic WD21X10490 latch to the top center of the cabinet frame, unplug the 3-wire harness, and snap in the new latch.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Beeping 3 Times / Start Light Flashing / Error 815)

Why does my GE dishwasher randomly beep in the middle of the night?
When the micro-switch inside the WD21X10490 latch degrades, slight temperature shifts cause the contact to open and close by itself, making the dishwasher wake up and chime.
